rightsNote: Seven Zhangzhugang images are used under their offered CC BY-SA 3.0 option; Ee0703 and Antigng images offer CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve source, photographer and licence links. No government image is republished.
held: Government aerial image has uploader CC label but original authority/licence not established; excluded.
Unidentified red church, generic skyline/night/river photos lack exact subject/location proof; excluded.
Duplicate angles, repeated plaques, alternate views of same sculpture and museum grounds excluded.
South Gate plaque omitted for visual depth; East Gate actual riverbank scene selected instead.
geographyLimit: Three files lack source camera coordinates: Hongqi Avenue, Yudu railway platform and Xie ancestral hall. Their named subjects are linked to primary town geography. No camera coordinate is invented.
sourceConflict: Xie hall street numbers vary among dated museum sources and are omitted.
review: Producing agent, parent and independent source reviewer approved nine distinct subjects. Exact Commons own-work declaration, authors, dates and chosen licences were independently checked. Original and delivered image hashes and dimensions were checked after processing.
